scenario: Prepare the launch package for a beta analytics dashboard aimed at operations managers and current design partners.

messages.text: Prepare the launch package for a beta analytics dashboard aimed at operations managers and current design partners.
I identified the content decision, the evidence needed, and the boundary that must stay human-owned.
Make it useful in a normal chat client and leave a durable handoff.
I produced outputs/content-operations-handoff.md, with facts, assumptions, open questions, and the next accountable owner separated.

report.title: Content operations session handoff
report.summary: An audience-specific brief, source-backed draft and channel assets, claim and approval ledger, and measurement plan, all marked publication-ready only after named approvals.

items.title: Content brief
items.summary: Every material claim has a source and every required approval has an explicit state

items.title: Versioned content draft and channel assets
items.summary: The asset matches the named audience, channel, action, voice, and acceptance criteria

items.title: Editorial checklist
items.summary: Never publish, schedule, or distribute content without the named channel owner and required factual, brand, legal, or executive approvals

items.title: Approval record
items.summary: The final answer names the accountable next owner and preserves the reusable artifact path.
